title: Data Scientist \"987402\"
description:
Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


Desenvolver, treinar e otimizar modelos de Machine Learning para resolver problemas de negócio, utilizando linguagens como Python ou R.

Realizar modelagem de dados, estruturando e preparando bases de dados para análises avançadas e para consumo por modelos estatísticos e preditivos.

Extrair, manipular e analisar dados utilizando SQL, garantindo qualidade, consistência e performance nas consultas.

Avaliar, validar e monitorar o desempenho dos modelos em produção, aplicando métricas estatísticas e ajustes contínuos para melhoria de resultados.

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas, documentando processos, hipóteses e resultados de forma clara e acessível.


O que você precisa ter


  • Python ou R;
  • SQL;
  • Pytorch.

Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Senior Property Manager
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re looking for an experienced Senior Property Manager to oversee operations, lead a team of junior property managers, and ensure smooth day-to-day management of residential and/or commercial properties. The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of U.S. property management, proven leadership skills, and the ability to balance tenant relations, administrative efficiency, and team management in a fast-paced environment.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Lead, mentor, and provide guidance to junior on-site property managers, ensuring best practices are followed across the team
  • Oversee tenant communications, lease renewals, and resolution of escalated tenant issues
  • Assist in managing leasing activities, including advertising, coordinating with your on-site team for property showings, applicant screening, and drafting lease agreements
  • Ensure compliance with lease terms, investigate violations, and address tenant disputes professionally
  • Supervise vendor coordination for maintenance repairs and upgrades, and coordinate with the on-site property manager for larger renovation projects
  • Collaborate with leadership on property marketing strategies and operational improvements
  • Oversee properties’ financial performance, including drafting budgets, tracking actuals to budget, and dictating strategies to maximize financial outcomes


What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong background in U.S. residential and/or commercial property management (required)
  • Previous experience managing or leading a property management team
  • Proficiency with AppFolio or similar property management software
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency with AppFolio or similar property management software



Why You’ll Love Working Here:


Competitive Compensation

We offer a competitive monthly salary of USD 1,500 - 2,500, based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

description:
Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. title: Senior Property Manager
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re looking for an experienced Senior Property Manager to oversee operations, lead a team of junior property managers, and ensure smooth day-to-day management of residential and/or commercial properties. The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of U.S. property management, proven leadership skills, and the ability to balance tenant relations, administrative efficiency, and team management in a fast-paced environment.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Lead, mentor, and provide guidance to junior on-site property managers, ensuring best practices are followed across the team
  • Oversee tenant communications, lease renewals, and resolution of escalated tenant issues
  • Assist in managing leasing activities, including advertising, coordinating with your on-site team for property showings, applicant screening, and drafting lease agreements
  • Ensure compliance with lease terms, investigate violations, and address tenant disputes professionally
  • Supervise vendor coordination for maintenance repairs and upgrades, and coordinate with the on-site property manager for larger renovation projects
  • Collaborate with leadership on property marketing strategies and operational improvements
  • Oversee properties’ financial performance, including drafting budgets, tracking actuals to budget, and dictating strategies to maximize financial outcomes


What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong background in U.S. residential and/or commercial property management (required)
  • Previous experience managing or leading a property management team
  • Proficiency with AppFolio or similar property management software
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency with AppFolio or similar property management software



Why You’ll Love Working Here:


Competitive Compensation

We offer a competitive monthly salary of USD 1,500 - 2,500, based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

title: Data Engineer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About your Team

At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.

Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.


The Impact You'll Make

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
  • Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
  • Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
  • Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.


About You

  • 2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Fluency in English is required
  • Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
  • Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
  • Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
  • Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
  • Hands-on experience with data lake technologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
  • Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
  • Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards

title: Desenvolvedor Java/Groovy Pleno
description:
Estamos procurando por alguém que goste de trabalhar com tecnologia, tenham facilidade em aprender e que tenha experiência sólida em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.

Se você é esse tipo desenvolvedor, queremos te conhecer!

Somos um lugar de inovação, por isso é muito importante ter em nosso time pessoas que gostem de aprender e compartilhar conhecimento.


Vem crescer com a gente!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como desenvolvedor Pleno você será responsável pelo:

* Desenvolvimento de componentes e páginas para os nossos produtos;

* Desenvolvimento de API's Restful;

* Revisão e garantia de qualidade de código e padrões da equipe de desenvolvimento;

* Criação de queries e scripts SQL;

* Desenvolvimento backend, front-end e testes unitários;

* Discussão em propostas de solução;

* Trabalhar em ambiente Linux para desenvolvimento;

* Vivência em práticas, técnicas e metodologias ágeis;

* Realizar versionamento de código com Git;

* Quando necessário, participar também de reuniões com stakeholders para levantamento de requisitos;

* Realizar apresentações de evolução e resultados para outros desenvolvedores e demais integrantes da equipe.


Requisitos e qualificações

Os requisitos abaixo são muito importantes para atuação como Desenvolvedor em nossos times.

* Saber analisar e resolver problemas;

* Ter boa lógica de programação;

* Dominar estrutura de dados e algoritmos;

* Conhecimento em HTML, CSS, JavaScript;

* Conhecimento de Design System e componentes reutilizáveis;

* Domínio de alguma linguagem orientada a objetos, preferencialmente Java ou Groovy;

* Saber fazer consultas complexas em Bancos de dados Relacional (SGBD);

Conhecimentos desejáveis, mas não eliminatórios

* Algum framework de backend (Grails, Spring ou Spring Boot, Hibernate, Micronaut, etc.);

* TypeScript;

* Elastic Stack - ElasticSearch/Kibana;

* Continuous Integration (CI);

* Container (Docker, kubernetes, etc.);

title: Senior Recruiter/Headhunter
description:
The role

Adsora is a performance marketing company focused on affiliate offers. We are hiring a senior recruiter who can run end-to-end hiring for high-impact roles, starting with a senior Meta media buyer who has recently scaled affiliate offers from $5k to $100k per day on Meta (proof required). Experience across YouTube, TikTok, and native is a plus.


This is not a “post a job and wait” role. You will hunt, qualify, and close talent. You will also own a set of VA-style support tasks that keep the hiring machine and daily ops moving.

We currently manage about $500k per month in Meta spend and we want to scale faster with A-level operators.


Mission

Build and run a predictable hiring pipeline that consistently lands operators who can scale paid social profitably, starting with a senior Meta affiliate media buyer.


What success looks like First 30 days
  • Fill the senior Meta buyer role (or have multiple final-stage candidates ready).
  • Build a clear scorecard and interview plan for the senior Meta buyer role (and next roles in the queue).
  • Launch outbound sourcing across multiple channels (LinkedIn, communities, referrals, databases, etc.).
  • Deliver a steady flow of qualified candidates each week (not just resumes).
  • Run structured screens that filter for real affiliate scaling experience, proof, and owner mindset.
  • Set up a clean tracking system for the pipeline (stages, notes, next steps, rejection reasons).

    • By 90 days
    • Fill 2-8 roles.


    By 12 months
    • Own recruiting as a system: documented sourcing playbooks, question banks, scorecards, and evaluation rubrics.
    • Consistently fill priority roles fast with high retention and high output hires.
    • Be the internal “talent operator” who can scale the team as spend scales.


    Responsibilities Recruiting and interviewing
    • Own the full recruiting cycle: sourcing, outreach, screening, interview coordination, follow-ups, references, offers.
    • Write and post job listings, then actively recruit instead of waiting for applicants.
    • Run structured screens focused on proof, recent performance, decision quality, and ownership.
    • Coordinate skills tests and case studies (and keep candidates moving quickly).
    • Build candidate packets for the hiring manager: summary, proof, strengths/risks, compensation expectations, notes.
    • Keep the process tight: fast response times, clean communication, no dropped balls.
    “Proof-first” candidate validation
    • Validate recent spend, results, and context (offer type, tracking, payout structure, constraints).
    • Spot inflated claims and surface the real story behind performance screenshots.
    • Ask the questions that reveal if someone can truly scale, not just maintain.
    VA and ops support (light but important)
    • Calendar management for interviews and internal meetings.
    • Inbox support for hiring related messages and candidate follow-ups.
    • Basic research tasks (talent lists, role benchmarks, competitor hiring patterns, community sourcing).
    • Keep docs organized (scorecards, interview notes, pipelines, templates, candidate folders).


    Who you are
    • You have recruited for performance marketing roles before (media buyers, affiliate marketers, creative, editors, tracking/ops).
    • You understand the language of direct response: CPA, CPL, EPC, payouts, margins, tracking, attribution, postbacks.
    • You can confidently screen a “senior Meta buyer” and know what real proof looks like.
    • You are persistent and comfortable sending lots of outbound messages without getting precious about rejection.
    • You write clearly and follow up like a professional. Candidates do not slip through the cracks.
    • You move fast, keep things organized, and you do not need hand-holding.


    Core values fit
    • Resourcefulness: You figure it out and bring options, not problems.
    • Good and fast beats perfect: You ship the first version, then improve.
    • Constructive disagreement: You call out weak logic and hype, respectfully.
    • Kind, not nice: You give honest feedback and protect the company from bad hires.
    • Growth mindset: You learn quickly and tighten the process every week.
    • Full ownership: You treat hiring like a revenue lever, not an admin task.


    Offer and compensation
    • Base pay (based on location and experience).
    • Performance bonuses tied to outcomes like roles filled and sustained for 3, and 12 months.
    • Long-term upside if you become our core talent operator as the team scales.


    How to apply

    Email with:

    • A short note on your recruiting background (what roles you have filled, and for what kinds of companies)
    • Your sourcing channels and process (what actually works for you)
    • 1–2 examples of candidates you successfully placed (role, why they were strong, how you found them)
    • Your availability and desired compensation (base + per-hire bonus expectations)

title: Head Comercial
description:
Quem Somos

A PayConductor.AI está construindo a plataforma de orquestração de pagamentos mais inteligente do mundo. Não somos apenas mais uma fintech, estamos desenvolvendo uma frota de agentes de IA especializados que otimizam rotas de pagamento, reduzem custos e transformam dados financeiros complexos em insights acionáveis em tempo real.

Acreditamos que pagamentos devem ser inteligentes, fluidos e auto-otimizáveis. Nosso time é enxuto, rápido e obcecado em construir tecnologia que realmente funciona.

Se você quer fazer parte de algo que ainda não existe em nenhum outro lugar, seja bem-vindo.


Descrição

Temos o produto mais inovador do mercado de pagamentos. Agora precisamos de alguém que faça o mercado saber disso.

Você vai construir a máquina de vendas da PayConductor do zero. Não é sobre seguir um playbook, é sobre escrever o playbook. Definir processos, montar time, criar materiais, fechar os primeiros grandes clientes, e escalar a operação.

Se você já vendeu SaaS B2B, entende o ciclo de vendas consultivas, e sente aquele brilho no olho quando fecha um deal complexo, queremos conversar. Se além disso você entende de pagamentos ou fintech, melhor ainda. Se não entende, vai aprender rápido, porque nosso produto praticamente se vende sozinho quando explicado direito.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir estratégia comercial, metas e processos de vendas.
  • Montar e liderar o time comercial (AEs e SDRs).
  • Criar playbook de vendas, materiais de apoio e argumentários.
  • Conduzir vendas enterprise pessoalmente nos primeiros meses (liderar pelo exemplo).
  • Definir e implementar CRM e ferramentas de sales enablement.
  • Trabalhar com Marketing para alinhar geração de demanda com capacidade de conversão.
  • Reportar métricas e forecast com precisão e consistência.


Qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B SaaS, preferencialmente em posição de liderança.
  • Track record de atingir e superar metas agressivas.
  • Experiência construindo times e processos de vendas (não só herdando máquinas prontas).
  • Habilidade de vender soluções complexas para múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Mentalidade data-driven, você sabe seus números de cor.
  • Capacidade de alternar entre estratégia e execução conforme necessário.
  • Comunicação excepcional e presença executiva.
  • Diferenciais: experiência em fintech/pagamentos, rede de contatos no mercado, experiência com vendas de soluções de IA.

title: Senior Recruiter/Headhunter
description:
The role

Adsora is a performance marketing company focused on affiliate offers. We are hiring a senior recruiter who can run end-to-end hiring for high-impact roles, starting with a senior Meta media buyer who has recently scaled affiliate offers from $5k to $100k per day on Meta (proof required). Experience across YouTube, TikTok, and native is a plus.


This is not a “post a job and wait” role. You will hunt, qualify, and close talent. You will also own a set of VA-style support tasks that keep the hiring machine and daily ops moving.

We currently manage about $500k per month in Meta spend and we want to scale faster with A-level operators.


Mission

Build and run a predictable hiring pipeline that consistently lands operators who can scale paid social profitably, starting with a senior Meta affiliate media buyer.


What success looks like First 30 days
  • Fill the senior Meta buyer role (or have multiple final-stage candidates ready).
  • Build a clear scorecard and interview plan for the senior Meta buyer role (and next roles in the queue).
  • Launch outbound sourcing across multiple channels (LinkedIn, communities, referrals, databases, etc.).
  • Deliver a steady flow of qualified candidates each week (not just resumes).
  • Run structured screens that filter for real affiliate scaling experience, proof, and owner mindset.
  • Set up a clean tracking system for the pipeline (stages, notes, next steps, rejection reasons).

    • By 90 days
    • Fill 2-8 roles.


    By 12 months
    • Own recruiting as a system: documented sourcing playbooks, question banks, scorecards, and evaluation rubrics.
    • Consistently fill priority roles fast with high retention and high output hires.
    • Be the internal “talent operator” who can scale the team as spend scales.


    Responsibilities Recruiting and interviewing
    • Own the full recruiting cycle: sourcing, outreach, screening, interview coordination, follow-ups, references, offers.
    • Write and post job listings, then actively recruit instead of waiting for applicants.
    • Run structured screens focused on proof, recent performance, decision quality, and ownership.
    • Coordinate skills tests and case studies (and keep candidates moving quickly).
    • Build candidate packets for the hiring manager: summary, proof, strengths/risks, compensation expectations, notes.
    • Keep the process tight: fast response times, clean communication, no dropped balls.
    “Proof-first” candidate validation
    • Validate recent spend, results, and context (offer type, tracking, payout structure, constraints).
    • Spot inflated claims and surface the real story behind performance screenshots.
    • Ask the questions that reveal if someone can truly scale, not just maintain.
    VA and ops support (light but important)
    • Calendar management for interviews and internal meetings.
    • Inbox support for hiring related messages and candidate follow-ups.
    • Basic research tasks (talent lists, role benchmarks, competitor hiring patterns, community sourcing).
    • Keep docs organized (scorecards, interview notes, pipelines, templates, candidate folders).


    Who you are
    • You have recruited for performance marketing roles before (media buyers, affiliate marketers, creative, editors, tracking/ops).
    • You understand the language of direct response: CPA, CPL, EPC, payouts, margins, tracking, attribution, postbacks.
    • You can confidently screen a “senior Meta buyer” and know what real proof looks like.
    • You are persistent and comfortable sending lots of outbound messages without getting precious about rejection.
    • You write clearly and follow up like a professional. Candidates do not slip through the cracks.
    • You move fast, keep things organized, and you do not need hand-holding.


    Core values fit
    • Resourcefulness: You figure it out and bring options, not problems.
    • Good and fast beats perfect: You ship the first version, then improve.
    • Constructive disagreement: You call out weak logic and hype, respectfully.
    • Kind, not nice: You give honest feedback and protect the company from bad hires.
    • Growth mindset: You learn quickly and tighten the process every week.
    • Full ownership: You treat hiring like a revenue lever, not an admin task.


    Offer and compensation
    • Base pay (based on location and experience).
    • Performance bonuses tied to outcomes like roles filled and sustained for 3, and 12 months.
    • Long-term upside if you become our core talent operator as the team scales.


    How to apply

    Email with:

    • A short note on your recruiting background (what roles you have filled, and for what kinds of companies)
    • Your sourcing channels and process (what actually works for you)
    • 1–2 examples of candidates you successfully placed (role, why they were strong, how you found them)
    • Your availability and desired compensation (base + per-hire bonus expectations)

title: Content Operations Manager
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.


Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support 1,000+ providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, LinkedIn, social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.



What You Will Do



Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings



Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams


Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable

title: Senior Recruiter/Headhunter
description:
The role

Adsora is a performance marketing company focused on affiliate offers. We are hiring a senior recruiter who can run end-to-end hiring for high-impact roles, starting with a senior Meta media buyer who has recently scaled affiliate offers from $5k to $100k per day on Meta (proof required). Experience across YouTube, TikTok, and native is a plus.


This is not a “post a job and wait” role. You will hunt, qualify, and close talent. You will also own a set of VA-style support tasks that keep the hiring machine and daily ops moving.

We currently manage about $500k per month in Meta spend and we want to scale faster with A-level operators.


Mission

Build and run a predictable hiring pipeline that consistently lands operators who can scale paid social profitably, starting with a senior Meta affiliate media buyer.


What success looks like First 30 days
  • Fill the senior Meta buyer role (or have multiple final-stage candidates ready).
  • Build a clear scorecard and interview plan for the senior Meta buyer role (and next roles in the queue).
  • Launch outbound sourcing across multiple channels (LinkedIn, communities, referrals, databases, etc.).
  • Deliver a steady flow of qualified candidates each week (not just resumes).
  • Run structured screens that filter for real affiliate scaling experience, proof, and owner mindset.
  • Set up a clean tracking system for the pipeline (stages, notes, next steps, rejection reasons).

    • By 90 days
    • Fill 2-8 roles.


    By 12 months
    • Own recruiting as a system: documented sourcing playbooks, question banks, scorecards, and evaluation rubrics.
    • Consistently fill priority roles fast with high retention and high output hires.
    • Be the internal “talent operator” who can scale the team as spend scales.


    Responsibilities Recruiting and interviewing
    • Own the full recruiting cycle: sourcing, outreach, screening, interview coordination, follow-ups, references, offers.
    • Write and post job listings, then actively recruit instead of waiting for applicants.
    • Run structured screens focused on proof, recent performance, decision quality, and ownership.
    • Coordinate skills tests and case studies (and keep candidates moving quickly).
    • Build candidate packets for the hiring manager: summary, proof, strengths/risks, compensation expectations, notes.
    • Keep the process tight: fast response times, clean communication, no dropped balls.
    “Proof-first” candidate validation
    • Validate recent spend, results, and context (offer type, tracking, payout structure, constraints).
    • Spot inflated claims and surface the real story behind performance screenshots.
    • Ask the questions that reveal if someone can truly scale, not just maintain.
    VA and ops support (light but important)
    • Calendar management for interviews and internal meetings.
    • Inbox support for hiring related messages and candidate follow-ups.
    • Basic research tasks (talent lists, role benchmarks, competitor hiring patterns, community sourcing).
    • Keep docs organized (scorecards, interview notes, pipelines, templates, candidate folders).


    Who you are
    • You have recruited for performance marketing roles before (media buyers, affiliate marketers, creative, editors, tracking/ops).
    • You understand the language of direct response: CPA, CPL, EPC, payouts, margins, tracking, attribution, postbacks.
    • You can confidently screen a “senior Meta buyer” and know what real proof looks like.
    • You are persistent and comfortable sending lots of outbound messages without getting precious about rejection.
    • You write clearly and follow up like a professional. Candidates do not slip through the cracks.
    • You move fast, keep things organized, and you do not need hand-holding.


    Core values fit
    • Resourcefulness: You figure it out and bring options, not problems.
    • Good and fast beats perfect: You ship the first version, then improve.
    • Constructive disagreement: You call out weak logic and hype, respectfully.
    • Kind, not nice: You give honest feedback and protect the company from bad hires.
    • Growth mindset: You learn quickly and tighten the process every week.
    • Full ownership: You treat hiring like a revenue lever, not an admin task.


    Offer and compensation
    • Base pay (based on location and experience).
    • Performance bonuses tied to outcomes like roles filled and sustained for 3, and 12 months.
    • Long-term upside if you become our core talent operator as the team scales.


    How to apply

    Email with:

    • A short note on your recruiting background (what roles you have filled, and for what kinds of companies)
    • Your sourcing channels and process (what actually works for you)
    • 1–2 examples of candidates you successfully placed (role, why they were strong, how you found them)
    • Your availability and desired compensation (base + per-hire bonus expectations)

title: Content Operations Manager
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.


Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support 1,000+ providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, LinkedIn, social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.



What You Will Do



Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings



Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams


Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable

    • Coordinate skills tests and case studies (and keep candidates moving quickly).
    • Build candidate packets for the hiring manager: summary, proof, strengths/risks, compensation expectations, notes.
    • Keep the process tight: fast response times, clean communication, no dropped balls.
    “Proof-first” candidate validation
    • Validate recent spend, results, and context (offer type, tracking, payout structure, constraints).
    • Spot inflated claims and surface the real story behind performance screenshots.
    • Ask the questions that reveal if someone can truly scale, not just maintain.
    VA and ops support (light but important)
    • Calendar management for interviews and internal meetings.
    • Inbox support for hiring related messages and candidate follow-ups.
    • Basic research tasks (talent lists, role benchmarks, competitor hiring patterns, community sourcing).
    • Keep docs organized (scorecards, interview notes, pipelines, templates, candidate folders).


    Who you are
    • You have recruited for performance marketing roles before (media buyers, affiliate marketers, creative, editors, tracking/ops).
    • You understand the language of direct response: CPA, CPL, EPC, payouts, margins, tracking, attribution, postbacks.
    • You can confidently screen a “senior Meta buyer” and know what real proof looks like.
    • You are persistent and comfortable sending lots of outbound messages without getting precious about rejection.
    • You write clearly and follow up like a professional. Candidates do not slip through the cracks.
    • You move fast, keep things organized, and you do not need hand-holding.


    Core values fit
    • Resourcefulness: You figure it out and bring options, not problems.
    • Good and fast beats perfect: You ship the first version, then improve.
    • Constructive disagreement: You call out weak logic and hype, respectfully.
    • Kind, not nice: You give honest feedback and protect the company from bad hires.
    • Growth mindset: You learn quickly and tighten the process every week.
    • Full ownership: You treat hiring like a revenue lever, not an admin task.


    Offer and compensation
    • Base pay (based on location and experience).
    • Performance bonuses tied to outcomes like roles filled and sustained for 3, and 12 months.
    • Long-term upside if you become our core talent operator as the team scales.


    How to apply

    Email with:

    • A short note on your recruiting background (what roles you have filled, and for what kinds of companies)
    • Your sourcing channels and process (what actually works for you)
    • 1–2 examples of candidates you successfully placed (role, why they were strong, how you found them)
    • Your availability and desired compensation (base + per-hire bonus expectations)

Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support 1,000+ providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions

  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices

Não somos apenas mais uma fintech, estamos desenvolvendo uma frota de agentes de IA especializados que otimizam rotas de pagamento, reduzem custos e transformam dados financeiros complexos em insights acionáveis em tempo real.

Acreditamos que pagamentos devem ser inteligentes, fluidos e auto-otimizáveis. Nosso time é enxuto, rápido e obcecado em construir tecnologia que realmente funciona.

Se você quer fazer parte de algo que ainda não existe em nenhum outro lugar, seja bem-vindo.


Descrição

Dados são o novo petróleo. Só que petróleo não precisa ser limpo, transformado, versionado e disponibilizado em tempo real para uma frota de agentes de IA famintos por informação. Dados precisam. E é aí que você entra.

Na PayConductor, estamos construindo a infraestrutura de dados que vai alimentar a próxima geração de inteligência em pagamentos. Não estamos falando de dashboardzinhos bonitos, estamos falando de pipelines robustos que ingerem dados de adquirentes, bandeiras, Banco Central, e transformam tudo isso em combustível para IAs que tomam decisões em milissegundos.

Se você acha que um pipeline bem arquitetado é uma obra de arte, que data quality é questão de honra, e que \"funciona na minha máquina\" não é resposta aceitável, vem com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados escaláveis para ingestão de múltiplas fontes (APIs de adquirentes, arquivos de bandeiras, dados regulatórios).
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e governança dos dados que alimentam os agentes de IA.
  • Construir data lakes e data warehouses que façam sentido (não aquele cemitério de tabelas que ninguém entende).
  • Implementar processos de ETL/ELT eficientes e monitoráveis.
  • Colaborar com o time de ML para garantir que os dados estejam no formato certo, na hora certa, no lugar certo.
  • Documentar schemas, linhagem de dados e processos como se o próximo engenheiro fosse um serial killer que sabe seu endereço.


Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida com Python e SQL (SQL de verdade, não só SELECT *).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e seus serviços de dados.
  • Familiaridade com bancos relacionais e não-relacionais.
  • Entendimento de princípios de data quality e data governance.
  • Capacidade de debugar um pipeline às 23h sem chorar (muito).
  • Diferenciais: experiência com dados financeiros/transacionais, conhecimento de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis), familiaridade com o ecossistema de pagamentos mundial.

title: Senior User Interface Designer
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade


Buscamos um(a) UX/UI Designer Sênior para desenvolver uma interface profissional no Figma que represente a identidade e os valores da nossa empresa. Entendemos que fluxo de navegação e design visual são diferenciais competitivos estratégicos, por isso precisamos de um profissional altamente qualificado para criar telas que combinem minimalismo e elegância, alinhadas à nossa solução.


Expectativas do Perfil


  • Nível sênior comprovado em UX/UI Design;
  • Disponibilidade de 4 horas diárias;
  • Postura proativa no acompanhamento dos desenvolvedores;
  • Alta capacidade de entrega com autonomia;
  • Excelência técnica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Comunicação clara e alinhamento constante com a equipe de desenvolvimento.


Descrição da Empresa


Somos especializados na coleta, análise e distribuição de dados jurídicos, conectando profissionais e empresas às informações essenciais para decisões mais assertivas. Com uma abordagem inovadora, desenvolvemos soluções que facilitam o acesso e o entendimento de dados complexos. Nosso objetivo é atuar como um hub de soluções jurídicas, oferecendo inteligência de dados para otimizar estratégias e aprimorar processos. Buscamos impactar positivamente nossos parceiros com ferramentas práticas e transformadoras.


Descrição do Cargo


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em UX/UI Design para integrar nossa equipe e contribuir com a criação de experiências digitais intuitivas e funcionais. As atividades incluem desenvolver protótipos de alta fidelidade no Figma, aplicar conceitos de design thinking e design visual, além de otimizar continuamente as interações dos usuários. Este é um cargo de meio período (4 horas/dia) com atuação 100% remota.


Qualificações Essenciais


  • Design e usabilidade: Domínio avançado de design thinking, prototipagem no Figma e práticas de design visual que equilibrem funcionalidade e estética;
  • Experiência do usuário: Experiência sólida em UX Design (User Experience Design);
  • Colaboração: Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com desenvolvedores, analistas de dados e equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente com alta qualidade de entrega;
  • Comunicação proativa: Perfil questionador e presente no dia a dia do desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais


  • Formação em Design, Tecnologia ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Portfólio demonstrando projetos de design minimalista e elegante;
  • Experiência com soluções B2B ou no segmento jurídico/dados.

title: Senior User Interface Designer
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade


Buscamos um(a) UX/UI Designer Sênior para desenvolver uma interface profissional no Figma que represente a identidade e os valores da nossa empresa. Entendemos que fluxo de navegação e design visual são diferenciais competitivos estratégicos, por isso precisamos de um profissional altamente qualificado para criar telas que combinem minimalismo e elegância, alinhadas à nossa solução.


Expectativas do Perfil


  • Nível sênior comprovado em UX/UI Design;
  • Disponibilidade de 4 horas diárias;
  • Postura proativa no acompanhamento dos desenvolvedores;
  • Alta capacidade de entrega com autonomia;
  • Excelência técnica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Comunicação clara e alinhamento constante com a equipe de desenvolvimento.


Descrição da Empresa


Somos especializados na coleta, análise e distribuição de dados jurídicos, conectando profissionais e empresas às informações essenciais para decisões mais assertivas. Com uma abordagem inovadora, desenvolvemos soluções que facilitam o acesso e o entendimento de dados complexos. Nosso objetivo é atuar como um hub de soluções jurídicas, oferecendo inteligência de dados para otimizar estratégias e aprimorar processos. Buscamos impactar positivamente nossos parceiros com ferramentas práticas e transformadoras.


Descrição do Cargo


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em UX/UI Design para integrar nossa equipe e contribuir com a criação de experiências digitais intuitivas e funcionais. As atividades incluem desenvolver protótipos de alta fidelidade no Figma, aplicar conceitos de design thinking e design visual, além de otimizar continuamente as interações dos usuários. Este é um cargo de meio período (4 horas/dia) com atuação 100% remota.


Qualificações Essenciais


  • Design e usabilidade: Domínio avançado de design thinking, prototipagem no Figma e práticas de design visual que equilibrem funcionalidade e estética;
  • Experiência do usuário: Experiência sólida em UX Design (User Experience Design);
  • Colaboração: Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com desenvolvedores, analistas de dados e equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente com alta qualidade de entrega;
  • Comunicação proativa: Perfil questionador e presente no dia a dia do desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais


  • Formação em Design, Tecnologia ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Portfólio demonstrando projetos de design minimalista e elegante;
  • Experiência com soluções B2B ou no segmento jurídico/dados.

title: PhD Peer Reviewer needed: Professor of Clinical Medicine
description:
Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work. Please read the recruitment requirements carefully. Thank you.


WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 30 papers in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI journals in the past five years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty: Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology: Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review: Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions: Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback: Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication: Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

title: Senior User Interface Designer
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade


Buscamos um(a) UX/UI Designer Sênior para desenvolver uma interface profissional no Figma que represente a identidade e os valores da nossa empresa. Entendemos que fluxo de navegação e design visual são diferenciais competitivos estratégicos, por isso precisamos de um profissional altamente qualificado para criar telas que combinem minimalismo e elegância, alinhadas à nossa solução.


Expectativas do Perfil


  • Nível sênior comprovado em UX/UI Design;
  • Disponibilidade de 4 horas diárias;
  • Postura proativa no acompanhamento dos desenvolvedores;
  • Alta capacidade de entrega com autonomia;
  • Excelência técnica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Comunicação clara e alinhamento constante com a equipe de desenvolvimento.


Descrição da Empresa


Somos especializados na coleta, análise e distribuição de dados jurídicos, conectando profissionais e empresas às informações essenciais para decisões mais assertivas. Com uma abordagem inovadora, desenvolvemos soluções que facilitam o acesso e o entendimento de dados complexos. Nosso objetivo é atuar como um hub de soluções jurídicas, oferecendo inteligência de dados para otimizar estratégias e aprimorar processos. Buscamos impactar positivamente nossos parceiros com ferramentas práticas e transformadoras.


Descrição do Cargo


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em UX/UI Design para integrar nossa equipe e contribuir com a criação de experiências digitais intuitivas e funcionais. As atividades incluem desenvolver protótipos de alta fidelidade no Figma, aplicar conceitos de design thinking e design visual, além de otimizar continuamente as interações dos usuários. Este é um cargo de meio período (4 horas/dia) com atuação 100% remota.


Qualificações Essenciais


  • Design e usabilidade: Domínio avançado de design thinking, prototipagem no Figma e práticas de design visual que equilibrem funcionalidade e estética;
  • Experiência do usuário: Experiência sólida em UX Design (User Experience Design);
  • Colaboração: Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com desenvolvedores, analistas de dados e equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente com alta qualidade de entrega;
  • Comunicação proativa: Perfil questionador e presente no dia a dia do desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais


  • Formação em Design, Tecnologia ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Portfólio demonstrando projetos de design minimalista e elegante;
  • Experiência com soluções B2B ou no segmento jurídico/dados.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados - BeFly
description:
Somos o ecossistema de turismo mais transformador na vida de cada pessoa! A paixão por viagens está em nosso DNA.

Nossos escritórios proporcionam um ambiente moderno e pensado para uma melhor experiência de trabalho presencial. Somos múltiplos e diversos, gostamos de trabalhar com gente do bem, de forma inteligente, prática, ousada, inovadora e com tudo isso, buscamos o extraordinário.

Valorizamos as conexões reais e ambientes leves, seja através do cafezinho no meio de expediente ou aquele papo, que sempre gera novas ideias.

O que nos move é a transformação e nosso lema é criar caminhos além do imaginável!

Isso nos torna BeFly. E aí, você vem com a gente?

#VemSerBeFly


Confira As Principais Atividades Desta Vaga

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Estruturar e manter arquiteturas de dados escaláveis (Data Lake / Data Warehouse) com foco em performance e integridade.
  • Integrar dados de diferentes fontes, incluindo sistemas legados, APIs e plataformas SaaS do setor de turismo.
  • Trabalhar com equipes multidisciplinares (engenharia, BI, produto e operações) para entregar soluções orientadas a dados.
  • Garantir qualidade, versionamento, governança e rastreabilidade dos dados.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de engenharia e contribuir para a definição da arquitetura de dados da empresa.


Curtiu?! Vamos em frente, entenda o que esperamos de você:

  • Forte domínio em Python e SQL.
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Dados (mínimo 5 anos)
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Airflow, Spark, dbt, Kafka.
  • Vivência com plataformas de cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e NoSQL.
  • Conhecimento em versionamento com Git e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Experiência no setor de turismo corporativo ou atuação em empresas de tecnologia com foco em mobilidade ou viagens.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas SaaS do setor de turismo, como:
  • OBTs (Online Booking Tools), ex: Argo, Reservia, SAP Concur, Onfly
  • GDS (Global Distribution Systems), ex: Amadeus, Sabre
  • Experiência com ferramentas analíticas e de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
  • Certificações cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experiência em projetos de dados com múltiplas integrações e alto volume transacional
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura orientada a eventos
  • Experiencia de implantação de data lake.


Quais os benefícios de ser BeFlyer?

  • VR iFood Benefícios | Para que você se alimente bem.
  • Vale-transporte | Para facilitar sua locomoção.
  • Assistência médica Bradesco | Mensalidade 100% paga pela BeFly ao colaborador titular e 50% para dependentes, com comparticipação.
  • Seguro de vida | Sem custo para o colaborador.
  • Assistência odontológica | OdontoPrev.
  • Wellhub | Para você cuidar da sua saúde física.
  • Day off de aniversário | Um dia de descanso no seu aniversário.
  • Programa de maternidade | Pacote com diversos cuidados para uma gestação tranquila.
  • Programa Oriente-me | Sessões de terapia sem custo adicional.
  • Estacionamento na sede | Desconto exclusivo para colaboradores.
  • Convênios educacionais | Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras.
  • BeFlyers Travel | Agência de lazer interna com condições especiais para colaboradores.

title: Consultor de Infraestrutura Sênior
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor(a) de Infraestrutura  para atuar em um projeto global, com foco no mapeamento do ambiente atual e na definição de Golden Images corporativas  para workstations e servidores, tanto em ambientes on-premises quanto cloud . 


Esse profissional terá papel estratégico na padronização de sistemas, fortalecimento da segurança, governança e sustentação da operação em escala global. 


Responsabilidades:   

  • Mapear os sistemas operacionais de workstations e servidores  em ambientes on-premises e cloud, garantindo visibilidade completa do cenário atual. 
  • Definir padrões globais de Golden Images  para workstations e servidores, considerando diferentes sistemas operacionais e necessidades regionais. 
  • Construir e documentar políticas, padrões e definições de segurança e infraestrutura , alinhadas a boas práticas e frameworks reconhecidos. 
  • Estruturar, detalhar e executar o plano de implementação  das Golden Images, acompanhando a execução junto às equipes técnicas. 
  • Definir um modelo de controles, governança e auditoria , assegurando aderência, rastreabilidade e manutenção dos padrões ao longo do tempo. 
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes globais, apoiando decisões técnicas e conduzindo alinhamentos em ambientes diversos. 

Requisitos obrigatórios:  

  • Consultor(a) de Infraestrutura , com experiência em padronização de ambientes, imagens corporativas e frameworks de segurança . 
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura e segurança de endpoints , incluindo hardening, baseline e controles de acesso. 
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos , com foco em execução, prazos e qualidade das entregas. 
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão , comunicação clara e gestão de conflitos  com equipes técnicas e stakeholders diversos. 
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de Endpoint Management , como Tanium e Microsoft Intune , será considerado um diferencial. 
  • Inglês fluente é obrigatório , para atuação em contexto global.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados - BeFly
description:
Somos o ecossistema de turismo mais transformador na vida de cada pessoa! A paixão por viagens está em nosso DNA.

Nossos escritórios proporcionam um ambiente moderno e pensado para uma melhor experiência de trabalho presencial. Somos múltiplos e diversos, gostamos de trabalhar com gente do bem, de forma inteligente, prática, ousada, inovadora e com tudo isso, buscamos o extraordinário.

Valorizamos as conexões reais e ambientes leves, seja através do cafezinho no meio de expediente ou aquele papo, que sempre gera novas ideias.

O que nos move é a transformação e nosso lema é criar caminhos além do imaginável!

Isso nos torna BeFly. E aí, você vem com a gente?

#VemSerBeFly


Confira As Principais Atividades Desta Vaga

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Estruturar e manter arquiteturas de dados escaláveis (Data Lake / Data Warehouse) com foco em performance e integridade.
  • Integrar dados de diferentes fontes, incluindo sistemas legados, APIs e plataformas SaaS do setor de turismo.
  • Trabalhar com equipes multidisciplinares (engenharia, BI, produto e operações) para entregar soluções orientadas a dados.
  • Garantir qualidade, versionamento, governança e rastreabilidade dos dados.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de engenharia e contribuir para a definição da arquitetura de dados da empresa.


Curtiu?! Vamos em frente, entenda o que esperamos de você:

  • Forte domínio em Python e SQL.
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Dados (mínimo 5 anos)
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Airflow, Spark, dbt, Kafka.
  • Vivência com plataformas de cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e NoSQL.
  • Conhecimento em versionamento com Git e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Experiência no setor de turismo corporativo ou atuação em empresas de tecnologia com foco em mobilidade ou viagens.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas SaaS do setor de turismo, como:
  • OBTs (Online Booking Tools), ex: Argo, Reservia, SAP Concur, Onfly
  • GDS (Global Distribution Systems), ex: Amadeus, Sabre
  • Experiência com ferramentas analíticas e de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
  • Certificações cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experiência em projetos de dados com múltiplas integrações e alto volume transacional
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura orientada a eventos
  • Experiencia de implantação de data lake.


Quais os benefícios de ser BeFlyer?

  • VR iFood Benefícios | Para que você se alimente bem.
  • Vale-transporte | Para facilitar sua locomoção.
  • Assistência médica Bradesco | Mensalidade 100% paga pela BeFly ao colaborador titular e 50% para dependentes, com comparticipação.
  • Seguro de vida | Sem custo para o colaborador.
  • Assistência odontológica | OdontoPrev.
  • Wellhub | Para você cuidar da sua saúde física.
  • Day off de aniversário | Um dia de descanso no seu aniversário.
  • Programa de maternidade | Pacote com diversos cuidados para uma gestação tranquila.
  • Programa Oriente-me | Sessões de terapia sem custo adicional.

title: CRO, UX Product Specialist (Onboarding, Content) | Remote, Part-time 20-30 hrs
description:
To Apply

Please complete this form:


LOCATION

Remote — Western Europe, Latin America (Argentina, Brasil/Brazil, Uruguay, Chile, Colombia)


About FullSession

FullSession is a user behavior analytics platform that helps teams understand how people really use their product or website, remove UX friction, and prove the impact of changes on activation, conversion, and revenue. Our customers span SaaS , Ecommerce/DTC , and Enterprise customer portals (finance, insurance, travel, etc.).

We’re building toward a world where teams go from seeing what happened → knowing what to fix next → validating lift.


The Role

We’re looking for a hybrid Product + CRO/UX Specialist who can wear three hats:

  • Customer onboarding & demo specialist: help prospects/customers get to “first value” fast (this is not a sales role)
  • CRO expert : diagnose funnel friction, propose experiments, and validate impact
  • Content contributor : turn real work into practical writing (CRO/UX playbooks, teardown-style posts, case studies)

This is a hands-on role. You’ll be in the product, in real customer journeys, and in front of customers.


What You’ll Do

CRO / UX & Experimentation:

  • Audit key journeys (signup → activation, onboarding, checkout, forms, critical flows) using session replay, heatmaps, funnels, and feedback.
  • Identify friction, quantify opportunity size, and prioritize a clear backlog of improvements.
  • Propose experiments and UX changes with strong hypotheses, expected impact, and success metrics.
  • Partner with product/engineering to specify changes (flow, copy, layout, instrumentation) and ensure tracking is correct.
  • Help validate lift (conversion, activation, completion, revenue per visitor, drop-off reduction) and document learnings.

Customer Onboarding & Demos (CS, not sales):

  • Run onboarding calls and product walkthroughs; help teams install/implement and reach “first insights” quickly.
  • Translate customer goals into a simple measurement plan (events/funnels) and a short list of “what to fix first.”
  • Collect structured feedback from calls and turn it into actionable product recommendations.

Writing & Thought Leadership (CRO/UX)

  • Co-create short, high-signal content with us: blog posts, case studies, teardown-style insights, and playbooks.
  • Share best practices for CRO, UX, and experimentation across SaaS, Ecommerce, and high-stakes portals.
  • Optionally publish under your name (with transparency/disclosure where relevant).


What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)

  • Customers reach “first value” faster (clearer onboarding, faster first insights, fewer setup blockers).
  • A repeatable onboarding playbook (talk tracks, checklists, templates).
  • A prioritized list of product + UX improvements informed by real data and real calls.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in CRO/UX optimization and/or Product Management for a live website/web app (B2B SaaS and/or Ecommerce).
  • Strong experimentation skills: hypothesis design, metrics, A/B testing fundamentals, interpreting results.
  • Strong analytics + behavior tooling experience (GA4 and a replay/heatmap/funnel tool such as FullSession, Hotjar, etc.).
  • Comfortable moving between quantitative and qualitative signals (funnels/events + replays/feedback).
  • Strong written English: you can explain what you found, what you changed, and why it mattered.
  • High ownership: you work independently, communicate clearly async, and ship work without heavy supervision.


Nice to have

  • Experience with onboarding/implementation for analytics tools (tagging, events, confirmation that data is flowing).
  • Familiarity with privacy considerations (masking, PII, consent, compliance).
  • Experience writing for Product/Growth audiences (LinkedIn, Medium, blog).


What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote-friendly engagement (start part-time 20+ hours; option to expand).
  • Fair compensation at $23/hr -- FT equivalent (173.3 hrs) = $3,986
  • Work on meaningful CRO/UX problems with modern behavior analytics tooling.
  • Direct exposure to product strategy and real customer journeys.
  • Opportunities to build your public portfolio via co-authored content.

title: TikTok & Meta Media Buyer
description:
We're hiring a TikTok & Meta Media Buyer to drive exceptional paid advertising results for a portfolio of enterprise and celebrity brands—plus fuel agency growth. Our client is a Gold Star TikTok Shop Partner led by a former TikTok employee and a seasoned agency owner. You'll manage high-budget campaigns and deliver record-breaking performance for our brand partners while scaling our agency through strategic lead generation campaigns.


What You'll Do:


Client Campaign Management:


  • Manage and optimize TikTok ad campaigns, driving maximum ROAS for D2C brands across feed ads, spark ads, live shopping ads, and product shopping ads.
  • Scale Meta advertising campaigns (Facebook & Instagram) using proven TikTok-to-Meta playbooks, leveraging winning creative and audience strategies across both platforms.
  • Run continuous A/B tests on creative, audiences, placements, and bidding strategies across TikTok and Meta to improve performance and scale profitably.
  • Analyze campaign data daily across both platforms to identify opportunities and optimize key metrics including ROAS, CPA, CTR, and conversion rates.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to develop high-performing ad concepts and provide data-driven feedback on what's working across TikTok and Meta formats.
  • Adjust budgets, bids, and targeting in real-time to maximize performance while minimizing wasted spend on both platforms.


Agency Growth:


  • Design and execute lead generation campaigns across Meta to attract enterprise and celebrity brand partners.
  • Test and optimize agency acquisition funnels, landing pages, and lead magnets to drive qualified inbound opportunities.
  • Track and report on agency marketing ROI, cost per lead, and lead-to-client conversion rates.


Strategic Collaboration:


  • Partner with Account Managers to align paid media with organic and affiliate strategies for cohesive brand growth.
  • Stay ahead of TikTok and Meta platform updates, beta features, and advertising best practices to maintain competitive advantages.


What You Need:


  • 2-4 years in paid social media buying with hands-on TikTok Ads Manager and Meta Ads Manager experience
  • Proven track record managing $100K+ monthly ad budgets for e-commerce brands across TikTok and Meta
  • Experience with B2B lead generation or agency marketing campaigns (preferred but not required)
  • Strong grasp of performance metrics: ROAS, CPA, CAC, LTV, CTR, CPL
  • Proficiency with TikTok Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and reporting tools
  • Excellent communication skills for presenting performance and strategy to clients
  • Creative eye for identifying winning ad concepts and adapting them cross-platform
  • Highly organized with ability to manage multiple high-budget accounts plus internal campaigns
  • Passion for performance marketing, platform trends, and growth marketing


What Success Looks Like:


  • Consistently exceed client ROAS targets while maintaining clients Top 10 partner status.
  • Successfully scale TikTok campaigns to Meta, achieving profitable expansion across both platforms.
  • Generate qualified agency leads at target CPL while optimizing conversion rates through the sales funnel.
  • Develop innovative testing strategies that uncover breakthrough audiences and creative approaches.
  • Proactively identify optimization opportunities and scale campaigns profitably.
  • Build trusted client relationships through transparent reporting and strategic insights.


The Team:


You'll collaborate with Account Managers, Creative teams, Affiliate specialists, and a Shop Operations team under our founding leadership. We're performance-driven and results-focused, maintaining our Top 10 ranking through constant innovation and testing. Everyone contributes ideas and insights to drive record-breaking results.


The Culture:


  • Performance Pioneers – Challenge conventional wisdom, test innovative strategies, and constantly seek improvements that exceed benchmarks.
  • Data-Driven Winners – Make decisions based on metrics and statistical significance, not gut feelings. Track everything and optimize relentlessly.
  • Brand Obsessed – Communicate clearly with clients, exceed their expectations, and build the trusted partnerships that make us the preferred TikTok Shop partner.

Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

  • Inglês avançado
  • Conhecimento em Informatica e SQL

  • Experiência em iImplementar workflows ETL no Informatica



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support
