title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Copywriter
description:
A Minha Biblioteca Católica está expandindo sua atuação para o mercado americano com o lançamento do My Catholic Library, clube de assinatura católico nos Estados Unidos.


Para essa nova fase internacional, estamos formando um time dedicado integralmente ao projeto, com talentos criativos, estratégicos e alinhados à nossa missão de inspirar a santidade e manifestar os grandes tesouros da fé católica. 


O(a) copywriter será responsável por criar textos estratégicos e criativos para Instagram, e-mails, anúncios e páginas de lançamento, traduzindo a essência da marca para o público americano, com foco em clareza, desejo e conversão.


Se você é uma pessoa criativa, com pensamento estratégico, domínio de copywriting e possui domínio do inglês, essa é a oportunidade ideal para fazer parte de um projeto católico com impacto global.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:
  • Criar copies para Instagram (feed, stories, reels e anúncios), alinhadas à identidade e ao posicionamento do My Catholic Library;
  • Desenvolver e-mails de campanha , fluxos de relacionamento e lançamentos, com foco em engajamento e conversão;
  • Escrever textos para anúncios pagos (Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads), explorando diferentes ângulos, promessas e gatilhos;
  • Criar páginas de lançamento e vendas (landing pages), estruturando narrativa, headline, argumentos e CTA;
  • Desenvolver roteiros e narrativas com foco em conversão, utilizando técnicas de copywriting, storytelling e gatilhos emocionais;
  • Adaptar mensagens para o mercado americano , considerando linguagem, cultura, contexto e comportamento do público;
  • Participar do planejamento de campanhas e lançamentos do My Catholic Library;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências de copywriting, marketing digital e comunicação no mercado dos EUA.


Conhecimentos e habilidades:
  • Experiência comprovada como copywriter, preferencialmente em marketing digital ou e-commerce;
  • Escrita clara, persuasiva e estratégica, com foco em conversão;
  • Experiência com copy para redes sociais, e-mail marketing, anúncios e landing pages;
  • Capacidade de adaptar tom de voz e linguagem para diferentes formatos e públicos;
  • Organização e capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplas demandas e prazos;
  • Inglês fluente (escrito), essencial para atuação no mercado americano;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade com entregas.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:
  • Experiência com lançamentos digitais ou clubes de assinatura;
  • Vivência ou familiaridade com o mercado americano;
  • Familiaridade com a cultura católica e com o universo da Minha Biblioteca Católica.

title: Copywriter
description:
A Minha Biblioteca Católica está expandindo sua atuação para o mercado americano com o lançamento do My Catholic Library, clube de assinatura católico nos Estados Unidos.


Para essa nova fase internacional, estamos formando um time dedicado integralmente ao projeto, com talentos criativos, estratégicos e alinhados à nossa missão de inspirar a santidade e manifestar os grandes tesouros da fé católica. 


O(a) copywriter será responsável por criar textos estratégicos e criativos para Instagram, e-mails, anúncios e páginas de lançamento, traduzindo a essência da marca para o público americano, com foco em clareza, desejo e conversão.


Se você é uma pessoa criativa, com pensamento estratégico, domínio de copywriting e possui domínio do inglês, essa é a oportunidade ideal para fazer parte de um projeto católico com impacto global.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:
  • Criar copies para Instagram (feed, stories, reels e anúncios), alinhadas à identidade e ao posicionamento do My Catholic Library;
  • Desenvolver e-mails de campanha , fluxos de relacionamento e lançamentos, com foco em engajamento e conversão;
  • Escrever textos para anúncios pagos (Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads), explorando diferentes ângulos, promessas e gatilhos;
  • Criar páginas de lançamento e vendas (landing pages), estruturando narrativa, headline, argumentos e CTA;
  • Desenvolver roteiros e narrativas com foco em conversão, utilizando técnicas de copywriting, storytelling e gatilhos emocionais;
  • Adaptar mensagens para o mercado americano , considerando linguagem, cultura, contexto e comportamento do público;
  • Participar do planejamento de campanhas e lançamentos do My Catholic Library;
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências de copywriting, marketing digital e comunicação no mercado dos EUA.


Conhecimentos e habilidades:
  • Experiência comprovada como copywriter, preferencialmente em marketing digital ou e-commerce;
  • Escrita clara, persuasiva e estratégica, com foco em conversão;
  • Experiência com copy para redes sociais, e-mail marketing, anúncios e landing pages;
  • Capacidade de adaptar tom de voz e linguagem para diferentes formatos e públicos;
  • Organização e capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplas demandas e prazos;
  • Inglês fluente (escrito), essencial para atuação no mercado americano;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade com entregas.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:
  • Experiência com lançamentos digitais ou clubes de assinatura;
  • Vivência ou familiaridade com o mercado americano;
  • Familiaridade com a cultura católica e com o universo da Minha Biblioteca Católica.

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

  • 2-4 years in paid social media buying with hands-on TikTok Ads Manager and Meta Ads Manager experience
  • Proven track record managing $100K+ monthly ad budgets for e-commerce brands across TikTok and Meta
  • Experience with B2B lead generation or agency marketing campaigns (preferred but not required)

  • Creative eye for identifying winning ad concepts and adapting them cross-platform
  • Highly organized with ability to manage multiple high-budget accounts plus internal campaigns

  • Generate qualified agency leads at target CPL while optimizing conversion rates through the sales funnel.
  • Develop innovative testing strategies that uncover breakthrough audiences and creative approaches.
  • Proactively identify optimization opportunities and scale campaigns profitably.
  • Build trusted client relationships through transparent reporting and strategic insights.

  • Data-Driven Winners – Make decisions based on metrics and statistical significance, not gut feelings. Track everything and optimize relentlessly.
  • Brand Obsessed – Communicate clearly with clients, exceed their expectations, and build the trusted partnerships that make us the preferred TikTok Shop partner.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:


looking for a kind and curious Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving challenging problems. Our awesome team of friendly humans is responsible for making it easy and compelling for individuals to consign items .

We place a strong focus on individual growth and personal development on our collaborative engineering team. As a Senior Software Engineer you will be an active hands-on contributor as well as a strong influencer for our technical direction.

You will be able to lead and contribute to significant initiatives as well as provide mentorship through code reviews and pairing.

We are especially excited about you if you are enthusiastic about working in the luxury retail/e-commerce space or if you are passionate about our mission of sustainability in creating a circular economy for high-end goods.

This role reports to the Engineering Manager of Customer Experience and will be fully remote.

title: Refunds Specialist
description:
ROLE

Property Leads is a fast-growing startup building cutting-edge lead generation and data solutions for the real estate industry. We're a lean, high-impact team of 20, solving complex problems at the intersection of technology, data, and growth.

We’re looking for an exceptional communicator and lead prospector capable of achieving remarkable results in the Refunds Specialist role at Property Leads. The successful candidate in this role must know that this is not a traditional 9 am to 5 pm job– evening and weekend work are required, and 40-60 hours per week are required.

You’ll work closely with our Senior Refund Coordinator and Customer Success Manager to collect data through text, phone calls, and email communication to process refunds accurately and efficiently.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to confirm the status of selling their home.
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to determine if they own the home.
  • Calling/texting/emailing seller leads to confirm if a mobile home for sale does/does not come with the land it sits on.
  • Move all prospects to the proper pipeline stage via CRM throughout the day.
  • Maintain a clear, up-to-date, and accurate pipeline in our CRM.
  • Follow up diligently and consistently with sellers over extended periods.
  • Document all interactions with prospects and clients in the CRM's “notes” section, escalating to Support or the Senior Refunds Coordinator as needed.
  • Process refunds with integrity, according to the refund policy.
RESULTS
  • Reach sellers promptly to help determine the outcome of declining/approving a refund request.
  • All sellers are promptly followed up with.
  • There is an effective line of communication between this role and the Senior Refunds Coordinator in which all necessary information is communicated promptly.
  • Continuously improve communication skills (Crucial Conversations book, etc.)
  • All internal communication cycles are adequately followed.
REQUIREMENTS
  • Proven work experience with cold calling or phone sales.
  • Proven work experience with text messaging/emailing in English.
  • You must enjoy being on the phone and speaking to sellers.
  • Excellent communication skills, including listening and facing conflict head-on.
  • Excellent at building rapport.
  • Willing to work in a fast-paced environment and rapidly grow.
  • Open to learning new processes in cold calling/seller outreach.
  • Self-sufficient and able to properly manage one’s own time.
  • Well-organized and able to maintain a pipeline that the Refunds Coordinator and sales Manager can observe and understand.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Experience as a real estate investor is preferred but optional.
  • Must pass written and verbal exams.

description:

Visão comercial (foco no cliente), dinamismo, organização, atenção aos detalhes, resiliência e foco em resultados.

Superior completo em administração, direito, ciências contábeis, engenharia ou áreas correlatas;

Pacote Office avançado.

Senioridade;

Não admitimos vitimismo, ideologia Woke e mentalidade congênere. Se você se identifica dessa forma, aqui NÃO é seu lugar.

Mapeamento das atividades e acompanhamento do cumprimento das tarefas no prazo estabelecido;

title: Analista de Pessoas e Cultura Pleno - Analytics
description:
Somos a Necta, empresa responsável pela distribuição de gás canalizado na região noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, abrangendo 375 municípios. O gás canalizado é uma fonte de energia eficiente, limpa e moderna, com ele, levamos desenvolvimento ao Noroeste Paulista, uma solução inteligente e sustentável para indústria, comércio, transporte e residências.

Existimos para conectar pessoas e negócios com o futuro.

Fazemos isso porque acreditamos que Segurança Vem Antes , que Juntos Somos Melhores , que precisamos Inovar para Superar e agir Hoje Pelo Amanhã . Esses pilares se completam e orientam a forma como pensamos, trabalhamos e construímos nosso caminho.

Na Necta, valorizamos a diversidade, por isso, incentivamos a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas negras, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas LGBTQIAPN+ e de todas as identidades.

Conecte-se com a gente e faça parte dessa transformação!


Estamos contratando: Analista de Pessoas e Cultura Pleno - Analytics


Se você tem olhar crítico, busca aprendizado contínuo e quer contribuir em um ambiente dinâmico e em transformação, essa pode ser a sua oportunidade!


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Elaborar, acompanhar e controlar o orçamento de pessoas, garantindo aderência ao planejamento financeiro;
  • Preparar projeções, previsões financeiras e análises de custo-benefício relacionadas às iniciativas e programas de RH;
  • Coletar, consolidar e analisar dados de Recursos Humanos, incluindo indicadores de recrutamento e seleção, retenção, desempenho, remuneração e benefícios, e jornada de trabalho;
  • Desenvolver, acompanhar e aprimorar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards para monitoramento dos principais indicadores de RH;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com as áreas de RH para identificação de tendências, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria a partir da análise de dados;
  • Assegurar a qualidade, consistência e integridade das bases de dados e informações de RH;
  • Gerar e apresentar análises, insights e recomendações estratégicas para apoio à tomada de decisão da liderança;
  • Realizar a gestão e o acompanhamento dos benefícios, incluindo custos, fornecedores e oportunidades de otimização;
  • Dar suporte na conferência e acompanhamento de prazos dos processos de folha de pagamento.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com indicadores, orçamento e análises gerenciais;
  • Conhecimentos em indicadores de RH (KPIs), métricas de pessoas e análise de dados;
  • Experiência na elaboração e acompanhamento de orçamento, controle de custos e análises financeiras;
  • Vivência em gestão e administração de benefícios, incluindo relacionamento com fornecedores e análise de custos;
  • Conhecimento dos processos de folha de pagamento, encargos e legislação trabalhista, com atuação em nível de acompanhamento e controle;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI ou similares).


Aqui na Necta Proporcionamos:

Assistência Médica – Nossos planos Unimed Seguros oferecem uma cobertura nacional abrangente.

title: Designer digital
description:
A Minha Biblioteca Católica está expandindo sua atuação para o mercado americano com o lançamento do My Catholic Library, clube de assinatura católico nos Estados Unidos.


Para essa nova fase, estamos formando um time dedicado integralmente ao projeto, com profissionais criativos, estratégicos e atentos a detalhes.


O(a) Designer será responsável por criar peças visuais para Instagram, anúncios, e e-mails, garantindo consistência estética, clareza de mensagem e alto padrão visual. Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na construção da identidade da marca e na geração de desejo e conversão no mercado americano.


Se você tem olhar estético apurado, domínio técnico e entende o design como ferramenta estratégica de marca e performance, essa vaga é para você.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:
  • Criar peças de design para Instagram (feed, stories, reels e destaques), alinhadas à estratégia de conteúdo e lançamentos;
  • Desenvolver layouts para anúncios pagos, respeitando formatos e boas práticas de performance;
  • Criar materiais visuais para e-mail marketing;
  • Garantir consistência visual a partir do posicionamento, identidade e diretrizes da marca;
  • Trabalhar a hierarquia visual, tipografia, cores e composição para clareza e conversão;
  • Adaptar peças para diferentes formatos, plataformas e proporções;
  • Interpretar e executar briefings estratégicos, propondo soluções visuais criativas;
  • Realizar ajustes e refinamentos a partir de feedbacks do time;
  • Organizar arquivos, versões e entregas dentro dos prazos definidos;
  • Acompanhar tendências de design digital, especialmente no mercado americano.


Conhecimentos e habilidades:
  • Experiência comprovada como designer gráfico ou digital para marketing e redes sociais;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design (Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign ou similares);
  • Experiência com design para redes sociais, anúncios e páginas digitais;
  • Capacidade de transformar conceitos estratégicos em peças visuais claras e atraentes;
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e comprometimento com prazos;
  • Abertura para feedbacks e ajustes contínuos;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado (para compreensão de briefings e referências internacionais).

title: TikTok & Meta Media Buyer
description:
We're hiring a TikTok & Meta Media Buyer to drive exceptional paid advertising results for a portfolio of enterprise and celebrity brands—plus fuel agency growth. Our client is a Gold Star TikTok Shop Partner led by a former TikTok employee and a seasoned agency owner. You'll manage high-budget campaigns and deliver record-breaking performance for our brand partners while scaling our agency through strategic lead generation campaigns.


What You'll Do:


Client Campaign Management:


  • Manage and optimize TikTok ad campaigns, driving maximum ROAS for D2C brands across feed ads, spark ads, live shopping ads, and product shopping ads.
  • Scale Meta advertising campaigns (Facebook & Instagram) using proven TikTok-to-Meta playbooks, leveraging winning creative and audience strategies across both platforms.
  • Run continuous A/B tests on creative, audiences, placements, and bidding strategies across TikTok and Meta to improve performance and scale profitably.
  • Analyze campaign data daily across both platforms to identify opportunities and optimize key metrics including ROAS, CPA, CTR, and conversion rates.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to develop high-performing ad concepts and provide data-driven feedback on what's working across TikTok and Meta formats.
  • Adjust budgets, bids, and targeting in real-time to maximize performance while minimizing wasted spend on both platforms.


Agency Growth:


  • Design and execute lead generation campaigns across Meta to attract enterprise and celebrity brand partners.
  • Test and optimize agency acquisition funnels, landing pages, and lead magnets to drive qualified inbound opportunities.
  • Track and report on agency marketing ROI, cost per lead, and lead-to-client conversion rates.


Strategic Collaboration:


  • Partner with Account Managers to align paid media with organic and affiliate strategies for cohesive brand growth.
  • Stay ahead of TikTok and Meta platform updates, beta features, and advertising best practices to maintain competitive advantages.


What You Need:


  • 2-4 years in paid social media buying with hands-on TikTok Ads Manager and Meta Ads Manager experience
  • Proven track record managing $100K+ monthly ad budgets for e-commerce brands across TikTok and Meta
  • Experience with B2B lead generation or agency marketing campaigns (preferred but not required)
  • Strong grasp of performance metrics: ROAS, CPA, CAC, LTV, CTR, CPL
  • Proficiency with TikTok Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and reporting tools
  • Excellent communication skills for presenting performance and strategy to clients
  • Creative eye for identifying winning ad concepts and adapting them cross-platform
  • Highly organized with ability to manage multiple high-budget accounts plus internal campaigns
  • Passion for performance marketing, platform trends, and growth marketing


What Success Looks Like:


  • Consistently exceed client ROAS targets while maintaining clients Top 10 partner status.
  • Successfully scale TikTok campaigns to Meta, achieving profitable expansion across both platforms.
  • Generate qualified agency leads at target CPL while optimizing conversion rates through the sales funnel.
  • Develop innovative testing strategies that uncover breakthrough audiences and creative approaches.
  • Proactively identify optimization opportunities and scale campaigns profitably.
  • Build trusted client relationships through transparent reporting and strategic insights.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Accounting Manager (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – LatAm

Salary: USD 2,500/month

Schedule: Based around US Timezones


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.


Responsibilities

Financial Close & Month-End Management

  • Lead the month-end close process, ensuring adherence to the timeline and checklist.
  • Review final profit & loss (P&L) scrub and approve journal entries prepared by staff.
  • Ensure the accuracy of the balance sheet workbook, including spot-checking source document filing.
  • Review and update financial notes, charts, graphs, and footnotes to ensure alignment with KPIs and executive summaries.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Oversee the preparation of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial reports through variance analysis.
  • Review staff-prepared financial statements and supporting schedules.
  • Ensure financial accuracy and consistency across all reports and KPIs.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow Management

  • Lead budgeting and forecasting efforts for real estate projects, including capital expenditures and operating costs.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support cost-saving initiatives and revenue growth.
  • Update and maintain cash flow forecasts regularly.

Tax Compliance & Regulatory Filings

  • Prepare and submit sales tax returns with controller approval.
  • Coordinate, review, and submit annual 1099s.
  • Support the preparation and submission of personal property tax filings, reviewed by the controller.
  • Calculate monthly sales tax payments and submit them for controller review and remittance.

Accounting Operations & Oversight

  • Manage recurring weekly accounting processes as outlined by the controller.
  • Review customer invoicing, vendor bills, and process payments.
  • Approve and submit payroll.
  • Perform chart of accounts reviews and reclassify contributions/distributions to retained earnings as needed.

Team Leadership & Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Supervise and mentor junior accounting staff, fostering development in real estate accounting practices.
  • Collaborate with departments including property management, acquisitions, and finance to ensure effective financial operations and decision-making.

Process Improvement & Client Advisory

  • Identify opportunities for process efficiencies and provide actionable recommendations to clients.
  • Maintain strong financial integrity, proactively troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

Tools, Communication & Task Management

  • Refine financial models and improve data structure in Excel.
  • Manage tasks using Asana and track time entries in Bizinta with detailed descriptions.
  • Organize and manage the accounting email inbox to ensure timely and accurate handling of financial documents.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of accounting experience, US based experience or familiarity required
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree.
  • Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is a plus and Advanced Excel skills is required (complex formulas, data structuring, and basic financial modeling).
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to prepare financial statements, carry out a month-end process, record and review journal entries in all accounts, and perform account reconciliations
  • Experience with US based clients and exposure to USGAAP.
  • US Working hours 9am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy , including all Holidays
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and QuickBooks Online
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;

  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;

description:
We’re looking for two full-time Virtual Assistants based in Brazil to join our global property management and real estate rental operations team. This is a fast-paced, service-driven role where you’ll communicate directly with guests and tenants across multiple properties, ensuring every experience meets our standard of excellence.


If you’re fluent in English, tech-savvy, and passionate about delivering outstanding customer service — this is a great opportunity to grow in an international environment.


⸻


Key Responsibilities


• Craft clear, professional, and empathetic English responses to guest messages, emails, and inquiries across Airbnb, VRBO and other internal platforms.

• Maintain a 5–10 minute response time to all messages during your shift.

• Deescalate and resolve guest complaints with professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment.

• Coordinate with cleaning, maintenance, and operations teams to fulfill requests.

• Update and monitor internal systems, CRMs, and property dashboards.

• Document all customer interactions accurately for team follow-up and quality control.

• Collaborate with team members to ensure seamless daily operations.


⸻


Requirements


• Fluent in English (spoken and written) – excellent grammar and communication tone.

• Strong typing skills (80+ WPM) and confidence navigating multiple platforms.

• High attention to detail, accountability, and ability to multitask under pressure.

• Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills.

• Must have a reliable laptop/computer and high-speed WiFi.

• Previous experience with Airbnb, property management, or hospitality support is a plus but not required.

• Professional, positive, and culturally aligned with a high standard of service.


⸻


Why Join Us


• Work 100% remotely from anywhere in Brazil.

• Full-time, consistent hours (40 hours/week).

• Competitive hourly rate in USD.

• Supportive, fast-growing international team.

• Career growth opportunities for high-performing team members.


⸻


If you’re ready to join a professional, global team that values reliability, communication, and excellence — we’d love to meet you.

title: Account Executive
description:
Near is a startup focused on bridging the gap between remote Latin American talent and companies hiring in the US and abroad. Our team spans 20+ members across four different countries. We've landed numerous great customers and have helped hundreds of people from LatAm improve their lives and wallets with jobs at US companies.


We're looking for a driven and entrepreneurial Account Executive who is autonomous, creative, and enterprising to join our team. This is a financially rewarding opportunity with a highly competitive compensation structure – uncapped commission. If you can source and qualify leads effectively, you'll make a lot of money.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute plans to achieve sales targets
  • Expand revenue originated from existing accounts
  • Create new opportunities through outbound prospecting.
  • Close inbound leads
  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships
  • Leverage our existing network to get referrals
  • Understand industry-specific landscapes and trends.
  • Become an expert in the staffing industry.


Qualifications:

  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Native-like English level
  • Demonstrated ability to problem solve and effectively manage time.
  • A proactive mindset: always pursuing your next goal.
  • Motivated by commission and career growth.
  • Track record of exceeding quota as SDR.


Traits that Would Make You a Strong Fit:

  • Proactive.
  • Optimistic and positive.
  • Intense, driving, and impatient (with regard to results and getting work done).
  • Pay attention to detail when necessary.
  • High EQ – can read the room and connect with people
  • Responds empathetic to others.
  • Follow-through skills.
  • Accountability


Benefits :

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Uncapped commission – the more you close, the higher your commission will be.
  • Results-focused role and team. No BS. No unnecessary processes and bureaucracy.
  • Opportunity to grow and work on larger and more complex deals.
  • A team with a great culture.
  • Join a team of high-performers.

title: Sourcer Senior
description:

Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing ;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos , apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;

  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Desejável vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas ;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Desejável Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Accounting Manager (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – LatAm

Salary: USD 2,500/month

Schedule: Based around US Timezones


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.


Responsibilities

Financial Close & Month-End Management

  • Lead the month-end close process, ensuring adherence to the timeline and checklist.
  • Review final profit & loss (P&L) scrub and approve journal entries prepared by staff.
  • Ensure the accuracy of the balance sheet workbook, including spot-checking source document filing.
  • Review and update financial notes, charts, graphs, and footnotes to ensure alignment with KPIs and executive summaries.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Oversee the preparation of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial reports through variance analysis.
  • Review staff-prepared financial statements and supporting schedules.
  • Ensure financial accuracy and consistency across all reports and KPIs.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow Management

  • Lead budgeting and forecasting efforts for real estate projects, including capital expenditures and operating costs.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support cost-saving initiatives and revenue growth.
  • Update and maintain cash flow forecasts regularly.

Tax Compliance & Regulatory Filings

  • Prepare and submit sales tax returns with controller approval.
  • Coordinate, review, and submit annual 1099s.
  • Support the preparation and submission of personal property tax filings, reviewed by the controller.
  • Calculate monthly sales tax payments and submit them for controller review and remittance.

Accounting Operations & Oversight

  • Manage recurring weekly accounting processes as outlined by the controller.
  • Review customer invoicing, vendor bills, and process payments.
  • Approve and submit payroll.
  • Perform chart of accounts reviews and reclassify contributions/distributions to retained earnings as needed.

Team Leadership & Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Supervise and mentor junior accounting staff, fostering development in real estate accounting practices.
  • Collaborate with departments including property management, acquisitions, and finance to ensure effective financial operations and decision-making.

Process Improvement & Client Advisory

  • Identify opportunities for process efficiencies and provide actionable recommendations to clients.
  • Maintain strong financial integrity, proactively troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

Tools, Communication & Task Management

  • Refine financial models and improve data structure in Excel.
  • Manage tasks using Asana and track time entries in Bizinta with detailed descriptions.
  • Organize and manage the accounting email inbox to ensure timely and accurate handling of financial documents.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of accounting experience, US based experience or familiarity required
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree.
  • Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is a plus and Advanced Excel skills is required (complex formulas, data structuring, and basic financial modeling).
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to prepare financial statements, carry out a month-end process, record and review journal entries in all accounts, and perform account reconciliations
  • Experience with US based clients and exposure to USGAAP.
  • US Working hours 9am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy , including all Holidays
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and QuickBooks Online
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

The People Operations and Support (POPS) Team at TGG handles both the operational and human sides of the business. We’re a tight-knit, cross-functional group that collaborates closely with leaders across the company and with each other. Our work is fast-paced and wide-ranging, and we’re always looking for better ways to support our people and help the business run smoothly.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability


For more information, write to

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles



Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Facebook Ads Media Buyer
description:
We’re Hiring: Facebook / LinkedIn Ads Media Buyer (Full-Time)

Remote (U.S. hours)

⏰ 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CST

Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is looking for a full-time Media Buyer to manage and scale paid traffic for our client portfolio, primarily in the financial advisory niche . This role is ideal for someone who is highly analytical, performance-driven, and comfortable managing multiple ad accounts at scale.


What You’ll Be Responsible For

• Manage 20–40 client ad accounts across Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and other paid channels

• Analyze ad creative, copy, audiences, and funnel performance to improve results

Bonus Points If You Have:

• Funnel optimization or conversion rate optimization experience

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles



Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Full Stack AI Software Engineers
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: React, Redux, Mui, react-query, react-table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities


Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label SaaS architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays

We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.

description:

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Accounting Manager (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – LatAm

Salary: USD 2,500/month

Schedule: Based around US Timezones


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.


Responsibilities

Financial Close & Month-End Management

  • Lead the month-end close process, ensuring adherence to the timeline and checklist.
  • Review final profit & loss (P&L) scrub and approve journal entries prepared by staff.
  • Ensure the accuracy of the balance sheet workbook, including spot-checking source document filing.
  • Review and update financial notes, charts, graphs, and footnotes to ensure alignment with KPIs and executive summaries.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Oversee the preparation of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial reports through variance analysis.
  • Review staff-prepared financial statements and supporting schedules.
  • Ensure financial accuracy and consistency across all reports and KPIs.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow Management

  • Lead budgeting and forecasting efforts for real estate projects, including capital expenditures and operating costs.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support cost-saving initiatives and revenue growth.
  • Update and maintain cash flow forecasts regularly.

Tax Compliance & Regulatory Filings

  • Prepare and submit sales tax returns with controller approval.
  • Coordinate, review, and submit annual 1099s.
  • Support the preparation and submission of personal property tax filings, reviewed by the controller.
  • Calculate monthly sales tax payments and submit them for controller review and remittance.

Accounting Operations & Oversight

  • Manage recurring weekly accounting processes as outlined by the controller.
  • Review customer invoicing, vendor bills, and process payments.
  • Approve and submit payroll.
  • Perform chart of accounts reviews and reclassify contributions/distributions to retained earnings as needed.

Team Leadership & Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Supervise and mentor junior accounting staff, fostering development in real estate accounting practices.
  • Collaborate with departments including property management, acquisitions, and finance to ensure effective financial operations and decision-making.

Process Improvement & Client Advisory

  • Identify opportunities for process efficiencies and provide actionable recommendations to clients.
  • Maintain strong financial integrity, proactively troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

Tools, Communication & Task Management

  • Refine financial models and improve data structure in Excel.
  • Manage tasks using Asana and track time entries in Bizinta with detailed descriptions.
  • Organize and manage the accounting email inbox to ensure timely and accurate handling of financial documents.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of accounting experience, US based experience or familiarity required
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree.
  • Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is a plus and Advanced Excel skills is required (complex formulas, data structuring, and basic financial modeling).
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to prepare financial statements, carry out a month-end process, record and review journal entries in all accounts, and perform account reconciliations
  • Experience with US based clients and exposure to USGAAP.
  • US Working hours 9am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy , including all Holidays
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and QuickBooks Online
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

The People Operations and Support (POPS) Team at TGG handles both the operational and human sides of the business. We’re a tight-knit, cross-functional group that collaborates closely with leaders across the company and with each other. Our work is fast-paced and wide-ranging, and we’re always looking for better ways to support our people and help the business run smoothly.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: TikTok & Meta Media Buyer
description:
We're hiring a TikTok & Meta Media Buyer to drive exceptional paid advertising results for a portfolio of enterprise and celebrity brands—plus fuel agency growth. Our client is a Gold Star TikTok Shop Partner led by a former TikTok employee and a seasoned agency owner. You'll manage high-budget campaigns and deliver record-breaking performance for our brand partners while scaling our agency through strategic lead generation campaigns.


What You'll Do:


Client Campaign Management:


  • Manage and optimize TikTok ad campaigns, driving maximum ROAS for D2C brands across feed ads, spark ads, live shopping ads, and product shopping ads.
  • Scale Meta advertising campaigns (Facebook & Instagram) using proven TikTok-to-Meta playbooks, leveraging winning creative and audience strategies across both platforms.
  • Run continuous A/B tests on creative, audiences, placements, and bidding strategies across TikTok and Meta to improve performance and scale profitably.
  • Analyze campaign data daily across both platforms to identify opportunities and optimize key metrics including ROAS, CPA, CTR, and conversion rates.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to develop high-performing ad concepts and provide data-driven feedback on what's working across TikTok and Meta formats.
  • Adjust budgets, bids, and targeting in real-time to maximize performance while minimizing wasted spend on both platforms.


Agency Growth:


  • Design and execute lead generation campaigns across Meta to attract enterprise and celebrity brand partners.
  • Test and optimize agency acquisition funnels, landing pages, and lead magnets to drive qualified inbound opportunities.
  • Track and report on agency marketing ROI, cost per lead, and lead-to-client conversion rates.


Strategic Collaboration:


  • Partner with Account Managers to align paid media with organic and affiliate strategies for cohesive brand growth.
  • Stay ahead of TikTok and Meta platform updates, beta features, and advertising best practices to maintain competitive advantages.


What You Need:


  • 2-4 years in paid social media buying with hands-on TikTok Ads Manager and Meta Ads Manager experience
  • Proven track record managing $100K+ monthly ad budgets for e-commerce brands across TikTok and Meta
  • Experience with B2B lead generation or agency marketing campaigns (preferred but not required)
  • Strong grasp of performance metrics: ROAS, CPA, CAC, LTV, CTR, CPL
  • Proficiency with TikTok Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and reporting tools
  • Excellent communication skills for presenting performance and strategy to clients
  • Creative eye for identifying winning ad concepts and adapting them cross-platform
  • Highly organized with ability to manage multiple high-budget accounts plus internal campaigns
  • Passion for performance marketing, platform trends, and growth marketing


What Success Looks Like:


  • Consistently exceed client ROAS targets while maintaining clients Top 10 partner status.
  • Successfully scale TikTok campaigns to Meta, achieving profitable expansion across both platforms.
  • Generate qualified agency leads at target CPL while optimizing conversion rates through the sales funnel.
  • Develop innovative testing strategies that uncover breakthrough audiences and creative approaches.
  • Proactively identify optimization opportunities and scale campaigns profitably.
  • Build trusted client relationships through transparent reporting and strategic insights.


The Team:


You'll collaborate with Account Managers, Creative teams, Affiliate specialists, and a Shop Operations team under our founding leadership. We're performance-driven and results-focused, maintaining our Top 10 ranking through constant innovation and testing. Everyone contributes ideas and insights to drive record-breaking results.


The Culture:


  • Performance Pioneers – Challenge conventional wisdom, test innovative strategies, and constantly seek improvements that exceed benchmarks.
  • Data-Driven Winners – Make decisions based on metrics and statistical significance, not gut feelings. Track everything and optimize relentlessly.
  • Brand Obsessed – Communicate clearly with clients, exceed their expectations, and build the trusted partnerships that make us the preferred TikTok Shop partner.

description:
To Apply
